summary.answer: allowbattlechatter and allowannouncer: neither key is set by any recovered HMH layer (corpus-wide script/tables search zero matches; absent from frontend 8360-8592, TU23 8719-8980, gametype def 8244-8639 and anchor bundle). allowbattlechatter PRODUCERS (script copies, all reading getgametypesetting(#allowbattlechatter) at init): mp_common/gametypes/battlechatter.gsc:109 stores raw (no isdefined guard): level.allowbattlechatter[bc] = getgametypesetting(#allowbattlechatter); mp_common/battlechatter.csc:27 uses isdefined&&value guard (client copy); core_common/dialog_shared.gsc:83 repeats the same raw store in a separate core_common system (dual install of the same setting, matching m1's dual-install note). CONSUMER GATES: battlechatter.gsc:333 skips specialist conversation when level.splitscreen || !level.allowbattlechatter[bc]; battlechatter.gsc:153-154 builds allowspecialistdialog/playstartconversation as mpdialog.enableherodialog/enableconversation AND allowbattlechatter[bc]; dialog_shared.gsc:116-117 same product expressions. The mpdialog bundle enableherodialog value lives in mpdialog_default bundle data NOT in the script corpus (m3 unit-9 unknown retained). allowannouncer: producer globallogic.gsc:5049 level.allowannouncer = getgametypesetting(#allowannouncer) (raw, no guard); consumer per m1's globallogic_audio record â€” announcer queue insertion first requires defined dialogkey and truthy level.allowannouncer, then either defined truthy self.playleaderdialog or defined truthy introdialog; the latter bypasses the player flag. Later queue guards still apply (see reused_records). Native defaults and actual audio delivery remain unknown. Absence semantics, kept conditional: for battlechatter.gsc:333 the gate blocks chatter when level.allowbattlechatter[bc] is falsy; under BOTH absent-key hypotheses (native returns undefined or 0) the stored value is falsy, so IF battlechatter init runs in the wz VM with no producer, the 333 gate blocks â€” the only escape is a native non-falsy return for the absent key, which is never observed in-source. For allowannouncer at 5049 an undefined return leaves level.allowannouncer undefined (falsy) â€” same conditional. ABSENT IS NOT FALSE as a data fact: no layer writes 0; the falsy outcome is a conditional consequence of the exact script expressions given an unproven native default. HMH-side leader-dialog key selection is separate: warzone.gsc:169-184 picks only among wzspectrerising/wzhardcore/wzzombieapocalypse (all absent from HMH layers) falling to key startWarzone â€” again conditional on absent-key falsiness.

summary.behavior: Non-dev battlechatter specialist dialog for enemy-destroyed gadget/equipment: gates in order - level.allowspecialistdialog true; attacker defined and isplayer and lacks perk specialty_quieter; gadgetweapon defined and NOT (owner defined and owner==attacker); attackerweapon (when defined) is not a killstreak weapon (killstreaks::get_from_weapon undefined); attacker has an mpdialog_player bundle; switch on gadgetweapon.name across 14 equipment identities (eq_sensor, gadget_spawnbeacon, claymore, eq_concertina_wire, gun_mini_turret, dog_ai_defaultmelee, seeker_mine_arc, ability_smart_cover, gadget_supplypod, eq_tripwire, trophy_system, eq_emp_grenade, eq_hawk, eq_shroud) with default return; on match threads function_5896274(mpdialog_value(enemyKillDelay,0), dialogkey, 2, undefined, undefined, cancel_kill_dialog) and for seeker_mine_arc additionally function_a43a3519. HMH-path limit: level.var_d2600afc is stored unconditionally in battlechatter __init__ (line 48, non-dev); 17 literal field-dispatch statements across14 files in2632 pinned GSC/CSC files; one statement/file is Zombies-only, leaving16 non-Zombies statements across13 files. The non-Zombies dispatch sites retain defined-pointer and their own weapon/attacker/owner/mode guards. The target also retains its dialog/player/perk/gadget/owner/weapon/bundle early-return gates. These are conditional potential source destroy routes; imports or a different battlechatter call do not prove those routes load or execute in an actual HMH VM; the dialog side effects require the HMH value of level.allowspecialistdialog (mpdialog bundle enableherodialog x getgametypesetting(allowbattlechatter)), which is unknown in this packet. The historical audited exclusion (sensor_dart wrapper function_4db10465 threading function_c142e8ec(undefined,undefined) so line 326 fails) is a path-level exclusion only - the same function_c142e8ec still dispatches at 338 for defined enemy attackers, and 15 other non-Zombies call sites (plus the separately scoped Zombies site) are untouched; no global exclusion is proposed.
